Eligible & Not-Eligible Candidates' List for Dr Sushila Nayar Hospital, Dharni
Thursday, 15 May 2025
2138 Hits
For the application invited for the various post at Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni, following is the list of eligible & not eligible candidates after scrutiny by scrutiny committee on the basis of criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
Non Eligible List - Temporary Ad-hoc basis
Not Eligible List - Temporary basis under AAVP Scheme
Eligible List - Temporary basis under AAVP Scheme
Eligible List - Temporary Ad-hoc basis
In case if any of the applicant is not satisfied with the reasons for ineligibility he/she may submit his/her representation, supported by documents as evidence. Please contact MS Office (Personal Section) before 26 May 2025, up to 5.00 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period. Representations without supporting documents will not be entertained.
lnterview Details: Eligible candidates are invited for interviews, which will be held on 28th May 2025, at 11:00 AM at Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni.
Medical Superintendent
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
